cgiar_basis: The label names the NERICA lines themselves, which the register treats as AfricaRice lines; a CGIAR line released directly is code 1 (BRRI dhan82, a pure-line selection within NERICA10, is coded 1). No NERICA line is approved in Bangladesh under that name: NSB 92 (2017-04-05, dec_id s092e) asked the technical committee to arrange release of the NERICA held by BADC in BADC's name, and no such release is in the register. A farmer who reports 'Nerica' may be growing BRRI dhan82, Binadhan-19 or Binadhan-21 (codes 1, 2, 2).
